newsitem.title: MOLDOVA: SOCCER-ZIMBRU CHISINAU WIN MOLDOVAN CUP ON PENALTIES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ZIMBRU CHISINAU WIN MOLDOVAN CUP ON PENALTIES.

text.p: Zimbru Chisinau, winners of all five Moldovan league titles since the post-Soviet championship was founded, finally added the cup to their trophy cabinet with an 8-7 win on penalties over Dnistru Otaci on Wednesday.
With the match scoreless after extra time, the game was finally decided by a save by Zimbru's Moldovan international goalkeeper Denis Romanenko from Dnistru's Sandu Guzun.
Their first-ever cup win will be consolation for Zimbru who look to have lost their chance of adding a sixth consecutive league title.
